rules.name: SQL Injection - Tautology / Boolean Bypass
rules.description: Detected classic SQL boolean tautology authentication bypass payload.

rules.name: SQL Injection - UNION SELECT Query
rules.description: Detected UNION SELECT query designed to extract database schema or records.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Stacked Commands & Piggybacked Queries
rules.description: Detected stacked SQL commands intended to modify or destroy database records.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Time-based Blind Functions
rules.description: Detected time-based blind SQL injection probe (SLEEP/BENCHMARK/WAITFOR).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - Script Tag Injection
rules.description: Detected explicit HTML <script> tag injection payload.

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - HTML Event Handler
rules.description: Detected inline DOM event handler injection (e.g. onerror=, onload=).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - JavaScript/Data Pseudo-Protocol
rules.description: Detected executable URI pseudo-protocol (javascript: or data:text/html).

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting - SVG / IFRAME Injection
rules.description: Detected HTML5 vector tag with active event handler.

rules.name: Path Traversal - Dot-Dot-Slash Relative Directory
rules.description: Detected directory traversal sequence attempting to navigate outside document root.

rules.name: Path Traversal - Sensitive System File Access
rules.description: Detected direct reference to critical operating system configuration files.

rules.name: OS Command Injection - Shell Operator with Binary
rules.description: Detected shell command separator chained with common system execution binaries.
